name: Design Direction & Tokens
notes: Atelier Lumière: warm parchment bg (#f5f1ec), terracotta accent (#b85c38), slate teal (#5c7a8a), DM Sans + Libre Baskerville typography

name: Scatter Plot with 10 Materials
notes: 10 procedural material nodes on 2D scatter plot with grid lines, axis labels, tick marks, smooth CSS transitions on axis change

name: Three.js 3D Viewport with Raking Light
notes: WebGL viewport with PlaneGeometry, MeshStandardMaterial, procedural canvas textures (color, roughness, normal), PointLight following mouse for raking effect, auto-orbit when idle

name: Procedural PBR Textures (10 materials)
notes: Brushed Oak, Slate Tile, Polished Marble, Woven Carpet, Brushed Concrete, Strand Bamboo, Natural Cork, Ceramic Tile, Herringbone Walnut, Terrazzo - each with color, roughness, normal maps from noise functions

name: Keyboard Navigation & Persistence
notes: Tab/Arrow key navigation on scatter plot, Enter/Space to select, localStorage persistence for axes and selected material

name: UI Polish & Loading State
notes: Loading spinner during texture generation, tooltips on hover, animated property bars, responsive resize handler, premium Atelier Lumière design language

name: Mobile Responsive Layout
notes: Stack panels vertically on narrow viewports, resize scatter plot and viewport

name: Material Search/Filter
notes: Search box to filter and highlight materials in the scatter plot

name: Material Comparison Mode
notes: Allow comparing two materials side by side with property bar overlays

name: Undo/Redo Selection History
notes: Track selection history with undo/redo buttons and Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y shortcuts

name: Export Material Data
notes: Export button downloads JSON with all material properties

name: Staggered Node Entrance Animation
notes: Nodes appear one by one with a staggered fade-in on first load

name: Number Key Shortcuts & Clear Selection
notes: Number keys 1-0 to select materials, clear button in details panel

name: Fix text overlapping in panel header (top right)
notes: Reduced search input from 180px to 150px, tightened axis-controls gap from 12px to 8px, reduced inline flex gap from 12px to 8px. First row now uses 769px of 832px available. Zero overlaps confirmed.

name: Fix header-right text overlap
notes: Fixed by adding .status-dot class to the green indicator span and updating CSS selector from .header-right span to .header-right .status-dot

name: Additional visual polish and refinements
notes: Added scatter container background gradient, improved node shadows/inner glow, refined grid line opacity, viewport inner shadow, details panel gradient, search input expand-on-focus
